description: Contains a class AppTheme that defines and provides the application's theme data, including theme colors, component styles, and system UI overlay styles, for a Flutter app.

classes.name: AppTheme
classes.description: A utility class that provides theme data configurations, including light theme customization, for the Flutter application.

methods.name: light
methods.description: Returns the ThemeData object configured for light mode, with specific styles for app bar, cards, dialogs, bottom navigation, inputs, buttons, and text.

methods.name: _colorScheme
methods.description: Private method that constructs and returns a ColorScheme object used in the theme, based on application's color constants.
